I'll look up the 2015 figure for Chinese students aged 13–15 who reported a physical fight at school in the past year.I cannot verify a single official 2015 figure for children aged 13–15 in China who reported a physical fight at school in the past 12 months. School-based surveys from that period (WHO GSHS and China youth-risk studies) generally put past-year physical fighting for this age group in the mid-teens overall, higher for boys than for girls, but that is not a confirmed “at school” point estimate for 2015.
